title: Building Scalable Web Applications with MERN
excerpt: A deep dive into architecture patterns for building production-ready MERN applications.
content:
The MERN stack has become one of the most popular choices for full-stack web development. In this post, I share my experiences building scalable applications using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js.

Architecture Patterns

When building a scalable MERN application, the key is to separate concerns properly. Use a layered architecture with clear boundaries between routes, controllers, services, and data access layers.

Performance Optimization

Implement caching strategies, database indexing, and code splitting to ensure your application performs well under load.

title: The Art of API Design
excerpt: Best practices for designing RESTful APIs that developers love to use.
content:
API design is both an art and a science. Well-designed APIs are intuitive, consistent, and easy to work with.

Consistency is Key

Use consistent naming conventions, error formats, and response structures across all endpoints.

Versioning

Always version your APIs to maintain backward compatibility as your system evolves.
